## Commit hygiene

- [ ] This PR represents a single ticket/issue (one ticket key across all commits, or a documented exception)
- [ ] The PR title repeats the same ticket key(s) as the commits, in the project's commit format
- [ ] No commit in this PR was made with `--no-verify`
- [ ] If multiple tickets are genuinely touched, each is listed above with a one-line reason
